notes.title: ILLWILL Update 1.10
notes.notes:
Dear friends. Thanks to everyone who supported me by buying the game. I have a New Year's gift for you. I thought, what kind of boomer shooter is there now without the dash mechanics and made a dash in ILLWILL. It seems to me that it plays much more cheerfully and dynamically.

[previewyoutube=8BPWUYDK53E;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] Added dash mechanics (I didn't change the locations and now you can dash into places you shouldn't go. Promise me that you won't abuse the game)
[*] Added cheat menu (type on numpad 17930 to open)
[*] Cosmetic weapon improvements
[/list]

[b]Warning![/b]
[i]By default, the dash works on the left shift, or the B button on the gamepad. If you have changed the controls before, you may need to bind these buttons again through the menu.
If the dash does not work on the gamepad. You need to delete the config file, which is located:

C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\Local\ILLWILL\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\Input.ini

The game will create a new config when launched and everything will work.[/i]

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Fun facts about the game
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] ILLWILL was inspired by Dusk

[*] The clock on the Meat Factory always shows a mirror image of real time. This is a reference that the game takes place in a parallel universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41243771/f6f66bdab110aa85c9dd43b79a0ad2dfee9388ca.jpg[/img]

[*] Initially, the model of the violin was planned differently. And the violin was used as a placeholder, but I liked the way it looked so much that I decided to leave it as it is. By the way, regular violins can be found in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41243771/64b41ee4ef34aa37bc7bfac72242e2a197cefce9.jpg[/img]

[*] Camel sounds were used to voice the monster Jade Toad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41243771/0afa6c1615726585da8aebbf23ca8e8a16402d3d.jpg[/img]

[*] Painhead's voice acting is the processed voice of the younger sister of our Sound Designer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41243771/715b0d94d49f32a14babfa310502907070a0a426.jpg[/img]

[*] Wormgun larvae suck the life out of opponents. But if you use them on Pigbot, they will restore armor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41243771/0034b8cb83435195f104b04658ddb26f817a6f04.jpg[/img]

[*] The Mammoth Rifle is a reference to the legendary double-barreled shotgun from Doom 2, which is considered one of the best fps weapons of all time. It works in a special way, the pellets pass through dead enemies, this feature allows you to mow down entire crowds of light enemies with one shot. I tried to recreate this mechanic in ILLWILL, and even started a separate channel for tracing bullets. But still, I was not able to convey this magical feeling from the legendary weapon from Doom 2. Nevertheless, the Mammoth Rifle in ILLWILL is very, very good.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41243771/f9b89bb95e8341362ac7ed3d248ee1512e496f0e.jpg[/img]

[*] In the room where the game starts. The number of marks on the wall is approximately equal to the number of days spent on the development of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41243771/244666437491f418a333d2d2379db67287cf6c11.jpg[/img]

[*] The dolls in the Dolls Factory level are from my other game called inlove. Which were inspired by artist John Kenn Mortensen. Later, on the basis of these dolls, Painheads and Mifiks were made. They are called Mifiks because they are very similar to Meeseeks from Rick and Morty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41243771/cb8e0b6dc57a3f160338f7c64b3ff9fea8123633.jpg[/img]

[*] All ammo pickups in the game are physical meshes with active moving parts. And the heart, on top of everything else, is still beating. Where else have you seen this? Okay, the beating heart was in Blood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41243771/6d56ae90d6b74d7ad9042ca75498f890e0bf7ed6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ILLWILL Patch 1.085
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Improved game stability
[*] Fixed a bug with the shot getting jam
[*] Added the ability to turn on the flashlight yourself
[/list]

The game now runs on the latest engine version 4.27. If you find any bugs, please write about it on the forum.
Many people told me that the game was quite dark, so I decided to add the ability to turn on the flashlight at any time. This did not affect the main functionality of the flashlight, it will also turn on automatically in dark places, as before.

If you have installed the game previously, you may need to bind the flashlight button manually, most likely due to a config conflict.

notes.title: ILLWILL
notes.notes:
I'm happy to introduce you to a feature that I've been working on for the past few months. 
These are game mods!
After beating the game, you will see a menu in which you can select one of the three modification.

[h2]Double Spawn[/h2]
In this modification, enemies will spawn 2 times more! More enemies, more challenge, more gore!

[h2]Lasergun Mastery[/h2]
Only one weapon will be available to you - the laser gun. By collecting ammo on the level, you will receive random upgrades that open up an alternative shooting mode. 
There are five upgrades in total:
[list]
[*] Plasma Bombs
[*] Spazer
[*] Blaster
[*] Homing Spheres
[*] Gravity Core (imba)
[/list]
[h2]Painhead world[/h2]
In this modification, all enemies in the game turn into Painheads. Also, Painheads explosions will one-shot the player.
A serious challenge for you.

Modifications will be available immediately on the release of the game.

GG
GL

notes.title: Release date announcement
notes.notes:
Finally, the long-awaited release of the game. After a long three years of development, I feel completely empty and do not know what to say.

Thanks everyone for the wait.
And remember big C'thulhu is watching you!

notes.title: Game release postponed
notes.notes:
Dear friends and all those who care about the fate of ILLWILL.

We were preparing for the release of the game on 1st December this year with the whole team. Unfortunately, we have made the difficult decision to postpone the release of the game until next year. The reasons for the decision are not enough wishlists and subscribers of the game. With numbers like that, there is a very high chance that the game page will simply get lost in the store.

Good news the game is ready. The extra time will allow us to make the game even better, add more content and run a marketing campaign.

We really hope for your understanding and loyalty.

notes.title: Your nightmare starts on 1st of December
notes.notes:
illWill is a first person adventure shooter where you will:

- Destroy dangerous monsters with different types of weapons in locations where every corner is fraught with danger
- Catching a nostalgia from friends from childhood mechanics
- Fight the bosses
- Run from Pain-heads!

WARNING!

After this game, a severe form of phobia may develop before opening various objects: bedside tables, cabinets, coffins. We don't know how to treat it, so all your complaints will be rejected.
